corpus.name: Modern school handwriting
corpus.description: Pages written by students in class, with a transcript that was checked by a teacher. There are no pages yet, so the accuracy of the recognition on this material is not verified.

measurement.what_is_measured: the raw recognition of the engine
measurement.no_corrections: the proposals of the spelling, of the grammar and of the scholarly style are not part of the measurement

note: the corpus has no page with a verified transcript, so the accuracy of the recognition on this material is NOT verified
